message: Astra: Stay with ActionsModule. You wrote “Test successful task execution,” but your test listings have no execution receipt; no executor is available here, so behavior remains unverified. Rather than another whole-code summary, what deserves closer attention in the current method and its test, and what observation would distinguish agreement from mismatch? Choose and perform one small static check now. Carry forward its finding, the exact code that supports it, what remains uncertain without execution, and your next specific intention—not a claim that tests passed.
